create_glm4v_video_processor: create a Glm4vVideoProcessor instance for preprocessing video inputs for the GLM-4.1V multimodal model
sample_frames_from_video: sample video frames at a target fps from VideoMetadata, returning evenly spaced frame indices within max_duration
preprocess_video_tensors: preprocess a list of video tensors by resizing, rescaling, normalizing, and patching for GLM-4V model input
resize_video_with_smart_resize: dynamically resize video frames to fit patch_size and temporal_patch_size constraints while respecting min/max pixel bounds
group_and_reorder_videos: group videos by spatial shape for batched processing and reorder them back to the original input order
